SELECT
FROM equipment_sensor_monitor m INNER JOIN equipment_sensor s ON m.sensor_id = s.id WHERE m.sensor_id = #{sensorId} AND m.delete_flag = 0 AND s.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT
FROM equipment_sensor_monitor m INNER JOIN equipment_sensor s ON m.sensor_id = s.id WHERE s.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND m.delete_flag = 0 AND s.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY m.sensor_id, m.create_time DESC ) t GROUP BY t.sensor_id
SELECT MAX(id) FROM equipment_sensor_monitor WHERE delete_flag = 0

SELECT
FROM equipment_sensor_monitor m INNER JOIN equipment_sensor s ON m.sensor_id = s.id WHERE m.id > #{lastMaxId} AND m.delete_flag = 0 AND s.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY m.id ASC
